content.title: Cadillac LYRIQ Archives - The California Lemon Law Expert
content.text: This 2024 Cadillac Lyriq developed malfunctions with the electrical systems, causing the emergency system warnings to flash on and off. While the vehicle was running, the emergency systems message would flash, the OnStar light would light up and the OnStar app would not work properly. These defects resulted in multiple visits to the dealership and produced serious safety concerns with the vehicle. The Vehicle Communication Interface Module needed a full replacement and software update to fix the electrical issues with the emergency systems. In a statutory repurchase of a lemon vehicle, your down payment, loan payments, towing charges, and rental vehicle charges are reimbursed to you. Additionally, all your attorney’s fees and costs are paid. Representing yourself against the big manufacturers puts you at a disadvantage. Get help! It’s Free.
